082        protected void setup() {
083                factors.clear();
084                stages.clear();
085                
086                setMaxProgress(PROGRESS_MAX);
087                
088                addStage(Stage.START, 0);
089                addStage(Stage.LEVEL_1, PROGRESS_1, StageIconSize.SMALL);
090                addStage(Stage.LEVEL_2, PROGRESS_2, StageIconSize.MEDIUM);
091                addStage(Stage.LEVEL_3, PROGRESS_3, StageIconSize.MEDIUM);
092                addStage(Stage.LEVEL_4, PROGRESS_4, StageIconSize.MEDIUM);
093                addStage(Stage.FINAL, PROGRESS_MAX, StageIconSize.LARGE);

095//              getDataFor(Stage.LEVEL_1).keepIconBrightWhenLaterStageReached = true;

098//              getDataFor(Stage.LEVEL_4).keepIconBrightWhenLaterStageReached = true;
099//              getDataFor(Stage.FINAL).keepIconBrightWhenLaterStageReached = true;
100                
101                addMarketFactor("sindria");
102                addMarketFactor("volturn");
103                addMarketFactor("cruor");
104                addFactor(new SDDFuelFactor());
105                addFactor(new SDDHighCommandFactor());
106        }

108        protected void addMarketFactor(String marketId) {
109                MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(marketId);
110                if (market == null || market.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) return;
111                addFactor(new SDDInstabilityFactor(market));
112        }

130        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode, boolean isUpdate, 
131                                                                        Color tc, float initPad) {
132                
133                if (addEventFactorBulletPoints(info, mode, isUpdate, tc, initPad)) {
134                        return;
135                }
136                
137                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
138                if (isUpdate && getListInfoParam() instanceof EventStageData) {
139                        EventStageData esd = (EventStageData) getListInfoParam();
140                        if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_1) {
141                                info.addPara("The Sindrian Diktat is beginning to suffer the effects of civil war.", tc, initPad);
142                        }
143                        if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_2) {
144                                info.addPara("The Sindrian Diktat is suffering mounting losses to fleets and industry.", tc, initPad);
145                        }
146                        if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_3) {
147                                info.addPara("The Sindrian Diktat cannot stop the devastation spreading across the Askonia system.", tc, initPad);
148                        }
149                        if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_4) {
150                                info.addPara("The Sindrian Diktat has been crippled by the ravages of war and insurrection.", tc, initPad);
151                        }
152                        if (esd.id == Stage.FINAL) {
153                                info.addPara("The Askonia system lies in ruin. The Sindrian Diktat has been effectively destroyed.", tc, initPad);
154                        }
155                        return;
156                }
157        }

188        
189        public void addStageDesc(TooltipMakerAPI info, Object stageId, float initPad, boolean forTooltip) {
190                float opad = 10f;
191                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
192                if (stageId == Stage.START) {
193                        info.addPara("The fleets and infrastructure of the Sindrian Diktat are in a condition much as they were in recent cycles.", initPad);
194                } else if (stageId == Stage.LEVEL_1) {
195                        info.addPara("The uniforms of the Sindrian Diktat are not quite so bright, the hulls of their ships not so perfect and polished. "
196                                        + "The effects of conflict are beginning to show themselves.", initPad);
197                } else if (stageId == Stage.LEVEL_2) {
198                                info.addPara("The state of Askonia can be seen in faces - no longer so eager for battle, but grim and fearful. "
199                                                + "Acrid smoke taints the atmo of warship and civilian hab alike, as both suffer violence and destruction.", initPad);
200                } else if (stageId == Stage.LEVEL_3) {
201                        info.addPara("Scars of rebellion and war are evident throughout the Askonia system. Cold wrecks drift on lost orbits; the corridors "
202                                        + "of civilian habitats have grown checkpoints and battle-damage.", initPad);
203                } else if (stageId == Stage.LEVEL_4) {
204                        info.addPara("Blasted derelicts drift where once trade convoys packed with fuel roamed. The cities burn, industry lies smoldering, "
205                                        + "and the skies are regularly filled with new novae of battle and slaughter.", initPad);
206                } else if (stageId == Stage.FINAL) {
207                        info.addPara("The Sindrian Diktat is in ruin. It's fleets are burned and scattered, or rife with mutiny; its planets engulfed in endless "
208                                        + "uprisings, their industries crumbling. The grim faces on the news-holos ask the silent question: what is there left to be fought over?", initPad);
209                }
210        }

212        public TooltipCreator getStageTooltipImpl(Object stageId) {
213                final EventStageData esd = getDataFor(stageId);
214                
215                if (esd != null) {
216                        return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
217                                @Override
218                                public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
219                                        float opad = 10f;
220                                        
221                                        if (esd.id == Stage.START) {
222                                                tooltip.addTitle("Untouched");
223                                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_1) {
224                                                tooltip.addTitle("Suffering");
225                                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_2) {
226                                                tooltip.addTitle("Faltering");
227                                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_3) {
228                                                tooltip.addTitle("Widespread Destruction");
229                                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.LEVEL_4) {
230                                                tooltip.addTitle("Devastated");
231                                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.FINAL) {
232                                                tooltip.addTitle("Absolute Ruin");
233                                                //tooltip.addTitle("Ddddddevastated"); // I'm so sorry we can't use this. But.
234                                        }
235
236                                        addStageDesc(tooltip, esd.id, opad, true);
237                                        
238                                        esd.addProgressReq(tooltip, opad);
239                                }
240                        };
241                }
242                
243                return null;
244        }

289        public void reportFleetDespawnedToListener(CampaignFleetAPI curr, FleetDespawnReason reason, Object param) {
290                if (reason != FleetDespawnReason.DESTROYED_BY_BATTLE && reason != FleetDespawnReason.NO_MEMBERS) return;
291                doSpecialFleetCheck(curr);
292        }
293        public boolean doSpecialFleetCheck(CampaignFleetAPI curr) {
294                if (curr.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.CADEN) &&
295                                curr.getFleetPoints() < 100) {
296                        String id = curr.getCommander().getId();
297                        if (personalFleetDefeats.contains(id)) return false;
298                        personalFleetDefeats.add(id, PERSONAL_FLEET_DEFEAT_TIMEOUT);
299                        addFactor(new CadenFleetFactor(curr.getName() + " destroyed", SDDPoints.CADEN_FLEET), null);
300                        if (SDResolution.get() != null) {
301                                if (curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) {
302                                        SDResolution.get().addFactor(new CadenFleetFactor(curr.getName() + " defeated", 
303                                                        SDRPoints.CADEN_FLEET), null);
304                                } else if (curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES)) {
305                                        SDResolution.get().addFactor(new CadenFleetFactor(curr.getName() + " defeated", 
306                                                        -SDRPoints.CADEN_FLEET), null);
307                                }
308                        }
309                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$cadenDefeatedDuringStandoff", true);
310                        return true;
311                } else if (curr.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.HYDER) &&
312                                curr.getFleetPoints() < 100) {
313                        String id = curr.getCommander().getId();
314                        if (personalFleetDefeats.contains(id)) return false;
315                        personalFleetDefeats.add(id, PERSONAL_FLEET_DEFEAT_TIMEOUT);
316                        addFactor(new HyderFleetFactor(curr.getName() + " destroyed", SDDPoints.HYDER_FLEET), null);
317                        if (SDResolution.get() != null) {
318                                if (curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) {
319                                        SDResolution.get().addFactor(new HyderFleetFactor(curr.getName() + " defeated", 
320                                                        SDRPoints.HYDER_FLEET), null);
321                                } else if (curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES)) {
322                                        SDResolution.get().addFactor(new HyderFleetFactor(curr.getName() + " defeated", 
323                                                        -SDRPoints.HYDER_FLEET), null);
324                                }
325                        }
326                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$hyderDefeatedDuringStandoff", true);
327                        return true;
328                } else if (curr.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.ACHILLES) &&
329                                curr.getFleetPoints() < 100) {
330                        String id = curr.getCommander().getId();
331                        if (personalFleetDefeats.contains(id)) return false;
332                        personalFleetDefeats.add(id, PERSONAL_FLEET_DEFEAT_TIMEOUT);
333                        if (SDResolution.get() != null) {
334                                SDResolution.get().addFactor(new AchillesFleetFactor(), null);
335                        }
336                        return true;
337                } else if (curr.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.HECTOR) &&
338                                curr.getFleetPoints() < 100) {
339                        String id = curr.getCommander().getId();
340                        if (personalFleetDefeats.contains(id)) return false;
341                        personalFleetDefeats.add(id, PERSONAL_FLEET_DEFEAT_TIMEOUT);
342                        if (SDResolution.get() != null) {
343                                SDResolution.get().addFactor(new HectorFleetFactor(), null);
344                        }
345                        return true;
346                }
347                return false;
348        }
349        
350        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
351                if (isEnded() || isEnding()) return;
352                
353                //if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
354                
355//              public static int CADEN_FLEET = 10;
356//              public static int HYDER_FLEET = 15;
357//              public static int FP_PER_POINT = 30;
358//              public static float FP_MULT_TRADE_FLEET = 0f;
359                
360                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
361                if (sindria == null) return;
362                StarSystemAPI askonia = sindria.getStarSystem();
363                
364                for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : battle.getSnapshotBothSides()) {
365                        if (curr.getContainingLocation() != askonia) break;
366                        
367                        if (curr.isStationMode() && curr.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty()) {
368                                boolean diktat = curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT); 
369                                boolean achilles = curr.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES);
370                                
371                                addFactor(new SDStationDestroyedFactor(SDDPoints.STATION_DESTROYED, curr.getName()));
372                                if (SDResolution.get() != null) {
373                                        if (diktat) {
374                                                SDResolution.get().addFactor(new SDStationDestroyedFactor(SDRPoints.STATION_DESTROYED, curr.getName()));
375                                        } else if (achilles) {
376                                                SDResolution.get().addFactor(new SDStationDestroyedFactor(-SDRPoints.STATION_DESTROYED, curr.getName()));
377                                        }
378                                }
379                        }
380                }
381                
382                
383                for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : battle.getBothSides()) {
384                        doSpecialFleetCheck(curr);
385                }
386                
387                float fpDestroyedDiktat = 0;
388                float fpDestroyedAchilles = 0;
389                float lgFPDestroyed = 0;
390                float fpDestroyedTrader = 0;
391                for (CampaignFleetAPI other : battle.getSnapshotBothSides()) {
392                        if (isSpecialFleet(other)) continue;
393                        if (other.getFaction() == null) continue;
394                        boolean diktat = other.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT); 
395                        boolean achilles = other.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES); 
396                        if (!diktat && !achilles) continue;
397                        
398                        boolean trader = Misc.isTrader(other);
399                        boolean lg = other.getName().toLowerCase().contains("lion's guard");
400                        for (FleetMemberAPI loss : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(other)) {
401                                if (trader) {
402                                        fpDestroyedTrader += loss.getFleetPointCost() * SDDPoints.FP_MULT_TRADE_FLEET;
403                                } else {
404                                        if (lg) {
405                                                lgFPDestroyed += loss.getFleetPointCost() * SDDPoints.FP_MULT_LG_FLEET;
406                                        } else {
407                                                if (diktat) {
408                                                        fpDestroyedDiktat += loss.getFleetPointCost();
409                                                } else if (achilles) {
410                                                        fpDestroyedAchilles += loss.getFleetPointCost();
411                                                }
412                                        }
413                                }
414                        }
415                }
416
417                int points = computeProgressPoints(fpDestroyedDiktat + fpDestroyedAchilles, SDDPoints.FP_PER_POINT);
418                if (points > 0) {
419                        addFactor(new SDShipsDestroyedFactor(points, ShipsDestroyedType.GENERAL));
420                }
421                
422                points = computeProgressPoints(lgFPDestroyed, SDDPoints.FP_PER_POINT);
423                if (points > 0) {
424                        addFactor(new SDLGShipsDestroyedFactor(points));
425                }
426                
427                points = computeProgressPoints(fpDestroyedTrader, SDDPoints.FP_PER_POINT);
428                if (points > 0) {
429                        addFactor(new SDDTradeShipsDestroyedFactor(points));
430                }
431                
432                if (SDResolution.get() != null) {
433                        points = computeProgressPoints(fpDestroyedDiktat + lgFPDestroyed, SDRPoints.FP_PER_POINT);
434                        if (points > 0) {
435                                SDResolution.get().addFactor(new SDShipsDestroyedFactor(points, ShipsDestroyedType.ABSOLUTIST));
436                        }
437                        points = computeProgressPoints(fpDestroyedAchilles, SDRPoints.FP_PER_POINT);
438                        if (points > 0) {
439                                SDResolution.get().addFactor(new SDShipsDestroyedFactor(-points, ShipsDestroyedType.REFORMER));
440                        }
441                }
442                
443                
444        }
445        
446        public static boolean isSpecialFleet(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
447                if (fleet == null) return false;
448                return fleet.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.HYDER) ||
449                                fleet.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.ACHILLES) ||
450                                fleet.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.HECTOR) ||
451                                fleet.getCommander() == People.getPerson(People.CADEN);
452        }
453
454
455        public static int computeProgressPoints(float fleetPointsDestroyed, float pointsPer) {
456                if (fleetPointsDestroyed <= 0) return 0;
457
458                int points = Math.round(fleetPointsDestroyed / pointsPer);
459                if (points < 1) points = 1;
460                return points;
461        }
